data.closure: ticks are candle timestamps; no explicit completed-bar flag in retrieved schema; exclude ongoing last bar by clock
data.mark_index: Current book contains mark/index; get_mark_price_history returned [] for tested current windows and docs indicate WS-only; historical series for these products unverified
data.pagination: GET tradingview_chart_data start_timestamp/end_timestamp, resolution=15; response ticks array; practical row/range cap not verified
data.trades: current last trades available; 2024-10-13 time-window probes returned empty for both despite positive candle volumes, so old trade depth unverified/limited

execution.client_order_id: User-defined label up to 64 characters, can group multiple orders; uniqueness/idempotency not documented
execution.custody: custodial CEX account/subaccounts with exchange margin/settlement
execution.isolated_margin: Only via dedicated subaccount; official support says default standard margin pools same-asset position margins
execution.key_permissions_no_withdraw: trade:read_write can be granted with wallet:read or wallet:none; wallet:read_write is withdrawal scope
execution.leverage: instrument max_leverage/max_non_default_leverage present; explicit per-position leverage setter not verified
execution.rate_limits: credit-based per-subaccount; get_instruments sustained 1 request/sec, burst 50; 10028 on exhaustion
execution.rest_ws: JSON-RPC over REST and WebSocket documented
execution.signing: OAuth-style client credentials or client_signature HMAC with timestamp/nonce; API key/token scopes
execution.sl_tp: Stop-loss/take-profit trigger orders and linked OCO/OTOCO documented
execution.status_feed: status.deribit.com probe failed proxy tunnel 403; public operational feed unverified

fees.api_specific: public instrument maker_commission/taker_commission agree with official Standard perpetual/futures schedule; no distinct bot API schedule found
fees.discounts_separate: VIP1 through VIP7, including negative maker rebates at VIP4+; excluded from ordinary base comparison
fees.literal_quote: Standard | None | Perpetuals and futures | Fees in bps (maker/taker) | 1.5 / 3.5
fees.unresolved: Actual account tier, broker/SMA fee or jurisdiction applicability require account confirmation; public standard used for ordinary comparison

funding.formula: Premium=(Mark-Index)/Index; uncapped=max(0.025%,Premium)+min(-0.025%,Premium); USDC perpetual cap shown +/-5%; payment=rate*position_size*(elapsed/8h).
funding.history_depth: Actual BTC and ETH 2024-10-13 hourly records retrieved; continuity beyond samples unverified.
funding.intervals: Continuously calculated and paid/received; quoted as 8-hour interest rate; cash balance settled daily at 08:00 UTC. Historical endpoint returns hourly interest_1h and interest_8h observations.
funding.sign: Positive: long pays short. Negative: short pays long.
funding.surcharge: None: venue says it charges no fee on funding, transfers between holders.
